summary: Spruce Power Holding Corp filed an 8-K on October 30, 2026, disclosing that certain subsidiaries entered a term sheet with a financial institution (the Refinancing Provider) contemplating a full refinancing of its SP1, SP2 and SP3 debt facilities. Concurrent amendments to the Second KeyBank Credit Agreement remove the approved refinancing term sheet delivery requirement, substitute a comprehensive long-term financial model due November 9, 2026, and condition the SP4/SP5 collateral addition solely on failure to consummate a qualifying refinancing by the Refinancing Deadline. No price, stake, premium or board recommendation stated; this is a routine debt refinancing/credit amendment, not a special situation.
